z_score_composite_mandate.purpose: 현 sleeve-blend (score_eff) → Z-Score Composite (z_composite_v1..v5) 결합 방식 redesign
variants_grid_3_to_5_autonomous: V1: equal weight normalized — z_comp = (z_core + z_def) / sqrt(2)
V2: equal weight simple — z_comp = 0.5 * z_core + 0.5 * z_def
V3: IC-weighted expanding — z_comp = w_IC_core(t) * z_core + w_IC_def(t) * z_def (w from expanding IC, t-1 lag PIT)
V4: regime-conditional — z_comp = α(regime) * z_core + (1-α(regime)) * z_def (BULL: core-heavy 0.7/0.3, BEAR: defense-heavy 0.3/0.7 or 자율)
V5: 자율 추가 (예: vol-targeted / drawdown-conditional / EM signal-amplification)
z_score_composite_mandate.selection_criterion: best variant = max SR / min MDD trade-off, AX-001 v2 conditional defense PASS, Harvey-t > 3.0, DSR pass
z_score_composite_mandate.PIT_compliance: C1-C15 all + C13 Z_Score_Aligned only (NEGATE_FACTORS 금지) + C14 Usable_Date <= sig_date + C15 load_month_factors 경유
